outlet: Goldendale Sentinel, "Siebert says transparency is key for PUD" (Lou Marzeles, 2026-07-29)
notes: Candidate interview: first-time candidate, owner of Siebert Custom Slaughter Meats; rate transparency; data centers should pay their share of the grid and not draw groundwater; private energy projects and PUD rates. The article calls the seat 'Position 1'; the ballot says Pos. 3.
